requirement.requiredInputs: Ship particulars, discharge record, and treatment-plant option compliance
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Discharge of sewage into the sea from category A and B ships constructed on or after 1 January 2017 and all passenger ships constructed on or after 1 January 2017 is prohibited, except when such discharges are in compliance with paragraph 4.2.1.3 of this chapter.
